name: lying-heel-touches.html
instructions:
1. Lay supine in a relaxed position with your knees up and arms straight out towards your feet.
2. Exhale hard and reach toward the base of your heel while contracting your abs and curling up.
3. Inhale as you slowly lower yourself back to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.
4. Complete for the assigned number of repetitions.
